phenotype_specificity.statement: 33391282: P31 had neonatal onset with omphalitis, ear discharge and fever, and CD18 < 2% (LAD1°), features the paper describes as common in LAD1°. Only ITGB2 Sanger sequencing is reported; no other genes tested. 22134107 gives no per-person features.

quotes.quote: | LAD1<sup>o</sup> | P31 | ♂ | 0.03 | 6 | No | Omphalitis, B/l ear discharge, fever, abdominal distention | Yes | Yes | *-* | 78561 | Alive |
Umbilical cord related complications like omphalitis (64%) and delayed separation (62%) were the most common manifestation seen in the LAD1° and LAD1^- cases.

Based on the CD18 expression on neutrophils, LAD1 was sub-classified into three phenotypes viz. severe (LAD1°) with CD18 expression <2% moderate (LAD1^-) phenotype with CD18 expression 2%–30%, and mild (LAD1^+) phenotype with CD18 expression ≥30%.
Molecular confirmation was performed was done using Sanger sequencing for LAD1 and next-generation sequencing (NGS) for LAD3.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Missense variant, p.(Cys36Ser), from the batch HGVS; 33391282 places it in exon 3, PSI domain. The paper describes LAD-I as autosomal recessive and caused by decreased expression or function of CD18 (beta-2 integrin).

quotes.quote: | PSI integrin | c.106T\>A | p.Cys36Ser | Exon 3 | Missense | P31 | CM120009 |
Leukocyte adhesion deficiency (LAD) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by decreased expression or functioning of CD18, the β_2 subunit of the leukocyte β_2 integrins [1].
Usually, this leads to the absence or decreased expression of the β_2 integrins on the leukocyte surface, but sometimes a normal expression of nonfunctional β_2 integrins is found.

concerns: 22134107 is a mutation-database update: the variant appears only as a Table 1 row with an accession number, with no case description, sex, clinical phenotype, zygosity or parental testing. (Applies to A0088.)

Possible same person, not merged by the pipeline: 22134107 lists c.106T>A as unpublished for A0088 (1 family, 2 alleles), and Manisha Madkaikar is an author of both 22134107 and 33391282; 33391282 lists P31 with an existing reference identifier (CM120009) rather than 'Novel', and says it includes 30 previously reported patients. The papers give no link between A0088 and P31; the panel should not count them as independent without checking.
33391282 gives no per-person zygosity: P31 lacks the '#' (heterozygous) mark, and the parents are consanguineous, which suggests but does not state homozygosity.
33391282 Supplementary Table 1 records P31's 'Umbilical Cord Separation' as 'No'; whether that means no delayed separation or no data is not defined.
33391282's supplementary text in this corpus is truncated after 60,000 characters (a note in the file says so); the P31 rows were present.
22134107 numbers cDNA from the A of the ATG (+1), which matches the batch numbering; it names no RefSeq transcript (it mentions GenBank M15395 only for the offset).
notes_for_panel: Two listings, probably one Indian patient or family: LAD-I^o/LAD1° (CD18 < 2-5%) with consanguinity. No case narrative.
